tickerItems: DUBAI FREE PORT EXHIBITION UNTIL 29TH JANUARY
heroImageAlt: Visitor painting a Dubai Free Port exhibition mural
heroDescription: Explore remarkable collections, authentic artefacts and historic spaces that bring nearly 250 years of Dubai's history to life.
discoverDescription: Explore remarkable collections, authentic artefacts and historic spaces that bring nearly 250 years of Dubai's history to life.
landmarkDescription: Discover the story of Al Fahidi Fort, from its construction in 1787 to its many roles as a defensive stronghold, seat of governance and Dubai's first museum. Explore how the Fort evolved alongside the city while remaining at the heart of its history.

stories.title: Memories of Al Fahidi Fort
stories.subtitle: The people who brought the Fort to life.
stories.description: Step into the lives of those who once passed through these walls. Through personal stories and immersive interpretation, discover the people, moments and memories that shaped Al Fahidi Fort across generations.
stories.imageAlt: Historic scene representing the memories of Al Fahidi Fort

stories.title: Defence Fortifications
stories.subtitle: A wider story of protection and resilience.
stories.description: Discover how Al Fahidi Fort connects to a wider network of forts and watchtowers across the Emirates.

stories.title: Islamic Arms and Armour
stories.subtitle: Centuries of craftsmanship.
stories.description: Explore one of the region's most significant collections of Islamic arms and armour.

oldestDescription: Built in 1787, the Fort has witnessed nearly 250 years of Dubai's history.
artefactDescription: The Fort is more than the setting for the museum. It is its most significant artefact, preserving the spaces where history unfolded.
collectionsDescription: Discover carefully preserved collections that reveal stories of defence, craftsmanship, leadership and everyday life.
sharedMemoryDescription: For generations, Al Fahidi Fort has connected people with Dubai's heritage through shared experiences, personal memories and lasting traditions.
